title: Stay, switch, or go freelance?
question: Should I accept the remote senior role at a 40-person startup, stay at my current company, or go freelance?
decided_by: Me, with input from my partner

options.name: Stay where I am
options.summary: Same team, promotion review in March

options.name: Go freelance
options.summary: Two warm leads, no signed contract

options.name: Re-interview at the big company
options.summary: Offer likely in ~6 weeks, hybrid 3 days

anchors.5: Owns a new area end to end

stability.note: Profitable, but a reorg is rumored

money.note: Public pay data for the level

startup.risk: Company folds; job hunt in 12-18 months

big-co.risk: Offer never comes; startup offer gone

lenses.name: The skeptic
lenses.view: You are scoring the startup's growth with pure judgment. Ask to speak with two engineers who left in the past year.

lenses.name: Me in five years
lenses.view: I will not regret a riskier job at 32 if my savings survive it. I will regret three more years on the same stack.

lenses.name: A friend who knows me
lenses.view: You always say you want to build things. The startup is the only option where that is the job.

premortem.story: Funding round fails in month 10; layoffs hit the newest hires.
premortem.signal: Board meeting slips, hiring freeze, runway updates stop.
premortem.mitigation: Keep 9 months of savings; refresh my network every quarter.

premortem.story: The 'own the platform' scope was a pitch; I end up on support duty.
premortem.signal: First 60 days without a roadmap I write.
premortem.mitigation: Get the scope in writing in the offer letter.

verdict.why: Wins on growth and daily life, which carry half the weight, and survives the gate. The lead depends on stability weight; that is the part to verify.
tripwires: Runway falls below 9 months with no round in sight: start interviewing.
After 90 days I still do not own a roadmap: escalate, then leave if nothing changes.
what_would_change_my_mind: Ex-employees describe churn or broken promises.
The big company makes an offer before 2026-11-06.
